summary: Iteration 12: New Calendario + Reschedule bundle for funzionabene.it. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases PASS across therapist CRUD calendar, admin aggregated monthly view, public terapista calendar, reschedule validate/confirm and booking reminder verification. Frontend: All 3 new pages render and function - Terapista Calendario (grid + timegrid + save/publish), Admin Calendario (monthly density coloring + drill-down), Riprogramma page (error card for bad token + assistenza mailto).
critical_code_review_comments: public/terapisti/{tid}/calendario uses ObjectId(terapista_id) with no try/except → invalid ID string will raise bson.errors.InvalidId (500 instead of 404). Consider wrapping.
reschedule confirm booked-slot check uses regex on data_ora string; safer to normalize with datetime comparison. Current works for ISO-8601 with same tz.
generate_reschedule_token_for_appt at bottom of calendario.py is unused (dead code) — the real token is generated inside booking_service.finalize_confirmed_booking. Consider removing.
AdminCalendario page default lands on current month (August 2026) which shows empty state; consider auto-jumping to the first month with data or showing a hint.
email_service.py line 137 puts inline conditional Python-style f-string logic inside HTML — hard to read; extract into a helper.
seed_data_creation: Test inserts a TEST_ tagged appuntamento with SHA-256 hash of 'TESTTOKEN12345' for reschedule flow validation, cleaned up in fixture teardown. Also temporarily overwrites Maria Rossi terapista disponibilita_calendario with 2026-02 + 2026-09 entries; last state left in place (Sep entries survive) — main agent may re-seed to clean if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: System clock is Aug 2026 (not Jan) — the reschedule endpoint requires nuova_data_ora > now+1h, so use ≥Sep 2026 dates. Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12_calendario.py (16 tests, ~4s). Frontend testids: terapista-calendario-page, admin-calendario-page, riprogramma-page/error/success, day-{key}, admin-day-{key}, slot-{data_ora}, save-draft-btn, publish-btn, confirm-reschedule-btn.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial admin-day cells count of 0 in first playwright pass was because default view is Aug 2026 which had no seeded published availability; navigating to Sep 2026 showed 31 cells with 2 covered (green) as expected.
